description: This PHP class 'EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator' implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and is responsible for configuring menu items related to employment status within the HR management system. The core method 'configure' overrides the current screen to 'employmentStatus'.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for employment status, overriding the current screen to 'employmentStatus'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'employmentStatus' and returns null for menu item.
